description: Set the global light shared by shadows and bevels (Object > Effects > Global Light), the transparency blend space (Edit > Transparency Blend Space) and how transparency is drawn on screen at each display performance level (Preferences > Display Performance)

blendSpace.description: Transparency Blend Space: Document RGB or Document CMYK

scope.description: Where global light and blend space are set: the active document, or the application defaults for new documents

transparencyDisplay.description: Transparency quality on screen per display performance level (application-wide)

highQuality.description: Transparency at the High Quality level

name: set_transparency_preferences
title: Set Transparency Preferences
